sections.content: Expressions of doubt and possibility such as es *posible* *que*, *puede* que and *quizá* can introduce the subjunctive when the speaker presents something as uncertain.

items.english: It is possible that he/she will arrive late.

items.spanish: Quizá el problema sea más complicado de lo que parece.
items.english: Perhaps the problem is more complicated than it seems.

sections.content: *Quizá* is the flexible one — it can take the subjunctive, as here, or the indicative depending on how confident the speaker feels — while es *posible* *que* and *puede* *que* always require the subjunctive.
